Weeknight Chickpea Curry

When I was a child in a small village, my grandmother would always tell me stories about curry, and those stories shaped my love for food. This recipe is the result of many years of experimenting, and I hope you love it as much as my family does.

Ingredients

  • 1 1/2 cups chickpeas, drained
  • 1 can coconut milk

Instructions

  1. Soften the onions.
  2. Simmer everything for 20 minutes.

Store leftovers in the fridge for up to three days. Reheat gently on the stove with a splash of water to loosen the sauce, which thickens overnight.

Great recipe!!! 5 stars
